8.3.5 SecOC_TpTransmit
[SWS_SecOC_91008]⌈
Service Name
SecOC_TpTransmit
Syntax
Std_ReturnType SecOC_TpTransmit (
PduIdType TxPduId,
const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x53
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.
Parameters (in)
TxPduId
Identifier of the PDU to be transmitted
PduInfoPtr
Length of and pointer to the PDU data and pointer to Meta
Data.
Parameters
(inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_Return-
Type
E_OK: Transmit request has been accepted.
E_NOT_OK: Transmit request has not been accepted.
Description
Requests transmission of a PDU.
Available via
SecOC.h
⌋(SRS_BSW_00323, SRS_BSW_00357, SRS_BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_00449)
For detailed description, see Section 7.4.
